svg.title: Tape Gateway: cache and upload buffer stay with the gateway
svg.desc: In this on-premises deployment, Tape Gateway runs as a virtual machine with separate local disk allocations for cache and upload buffer. Cache retains recently accessed tape data and pending writes; the buffer stages uploads. S3 holds virtual tape data. Ejected tapes move to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval or Deep Archive. On EC2, the gateway cache is attached storage on the EC2 gateway instance.

g.text: Tape Gateway: cache and upload buffer stay with the gateway
Backup software uses virtual tape devices; the gateway stores tape data in AWS.
DISKS ALLOCATED TO THIS GATEWAY VM
Recent tape data + writes awaiting upload
AWS ARCHIVE — select a tape pool
Retrieve an archived tape to the virtual tape library (VTL) before backup software can read it.
Location on EC2: the cache and upload buffer use storage attached to the EC2 gateway instance.
iSCSI = Internet Small Computer System Interface: the protocol used here to access virtual tape devices.
